## Marcus Corporation Announces Third Quarter 2026 Release Date and Conference Call


October 15, 2026


MILWAUKEE--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Marcus Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com&esheet=54623045&newsitemid=20261015422993&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Corporation&index=1&md5=f2b0d8ade7c2b0e2327f19711a27fbcc) (NYSE: MCS) today announced it will report results for the third quarter of 2026 prior to the stock market open on Thursday, October 29, 2026. The release will be followed by a conference call at 10:00 a.m. Central/11:00 a.m. Eastern time.


Participants may listen to the call live on the internet through the investor relations section of the company's website:[investors.marcuscorp.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.marcuscorp.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54623045&newsitemid=20261015422993&lan=en-US&anchor=investors.marcuscorp.com&index=2&md5=8357a63021a99a257c7c1f5d0c6ebc58) , or by dialing 1-626-884-3620 and entering the meeting ID 600793939. Listeners should dial in to the call at least 5-10 minutes prior to the start of the call or should go to the website at least 15 minutes prior to the call to download and install any necessary audio software.


A replay of the conference call will be archived on the company’s website until its next earnings release.


**About Marcus Corporation**


Headquartered in Milwaukee,[Marcus Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2F&esheet=54623045&newsitemid=20261015422993&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Corporation&index=3&md5=44393c02bc144a10a44f058c3785b0b7) is a leader in the entertainment and hospitality industries, with significant company-owned real estate assets. Marcus Corporation’s theatre division,[Marcus Theatres®](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcustheatres.com%2F&esheet=54623045&newsitemid=20261015422993&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus+Theatres%26%23174%3B&index=4&md5=462c970537d24405877e898abbfb0292) , is the fourth largest theatre circuit in the U.S. and currently owns or operates 975 screens at 77 locations in 17 states under the Marcus Theatres, Movie Tavern® by Marcus and Bistro *Plex* ® brands. The company’s hospitality division,[Marcus® Hotels & Resorts](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcushotels.com%2F&esheet=54623045&newsitemid=20261015422993&lan=en-US&anchor=Marcus%26%23174%3B+Hotels+%26amp%3B+Resorts&index=5&md5=24961b82eee719730463da5080919675) , owns and/or manages 17 hotels, resorts and other properties in eight states. For more information, please visit the company’s website at[www.marcuscorp.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marcuscorp.com%2F&esheet=54623045&newsitemid=20261015422993&lan=en-US&anchor=www.marcuscorp.com&index=6&md5=84831d8c4e09e66d85b7a79c6fdb5993) .
